name: com.rokid.glass.mobileapp.remotecooperation.activity.ConferenceMainActivity
description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this screen after a user joins a meeting. It shows the participants and meeting status, provides call controls, and opens screen sharing, whiteboard, or camera views.
disableEffect: Users cannot enter or stay in the meeting screen, so Rokid Remote Cooperation calls and meetings are unusable.
